name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: On this day 161 years ago
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
We've fought hard for our progress toward justice, but there's still so much work that needs to be done.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260619-6377-footer&t=1&akid=6377%2E420207%2EySvQ54)
Peter,
**On this day 161 years ago, slavery was finally ended in America. It was on June 19th, 1865 that Union soldiers landed at Galveston, Texas with news that enslaved people were now free.**
Today is a stark reminder of our collective history. We've fought hard for our progress toward justice, but there's still so much work that needs to be done. Our country still has a long way to go to make equality real and address nearly a century of oppressive Jim Crow laws in America.
In Congress, and in my everyday commitment to serving the American people, I constantly discuss the pressing issues that have plagued our communities for far too long.
**Issues such as:**
* America's for-profit health care system leaves Black Americans much more likely to be uninsured than white Americans.

* America's deeply, deeply unequal economy.

* America's housing system with devastating generational trauma, exclusionary redlining, and discriminatory financial practices that shut out people of color and fuel racial injustice.

* Ecological racism in countless neighborhoods that are perpetually flooded with toxic dump sites and lack of access to clean air, safe drinking water, and public lands.

* America's education system institutionalized discrimination to the extent that the schoolhouse to jailhouse pipeline begins as early as kindergarten.

* And our justice system which is patently unjust.

**Every single system is connected** — all discriminatory and intertwined, threads of injustice that come together to hold people back.
That is why I am committed to delivering the urgent legislative solutions this moment demands and tackling the challenges facing our communities head-on. Solutions like Medicare For All, the Housing Is A Human Right Act, the College For All Act, just immigration reform, a livable wage, and more.
**When we take back the House this November — and when we elect a progressive Democratic president in 2028 — we can’t continue to act as if incremental change is enough.**
I came to Congress to set things straight and fight for what matters and what we deserve. This Juneteenth and each day moving forward, I pledge to you that I will fight for real change, in solidarity with the Black community and with all of us who believe in a better world.
Thank you for doing this work with me: with urgency, with generosity, with the belief that we can change things if we remain dedicated to our collective vision.
Thank you,
Pramila

name: Mike Thompson
subject: Celebrating Freedom
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mike Thompson For Congress unsubscribe: https://support
body:
# [#]
Peter,Happy Juneteenth! Today we mark a pivotal moment in history, when the last enslaved people in Galveston, TX, finally learned of their freedom on June 19, 1865, more than two years after the Emancipation Proclamation was signed.

For many Black Americans, including members of our own community, Juneteenth carries deep historical and personal significance. It is a time to honor the resilience, achievements, culture and contributions of Black Americans throughout our nation’s history and within our own community.

We proudly honor the day when the promise of equality took another step forward, while remembering that the fight for civil rights is far from finished.

Even as MAGA attempts to disenfranchise Black voices through the repeal of the Voting Rights Act, please know that I will remain steadfast in the fight to defend Black Americans’ civil liberties.

Thank you,
Mike Thompson

# [Meta begs Congress for full immunity from child harm lawsuits](https://substack.com/redirect/1dcc6802-3ea2-4c98-912b-2e112e97ae5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Meta is seeking sweeping **[legal immunity from lawsuits alleging its platforms harm children](https://substack.com/redirect/b63293a9-b0a4-4942-8d12-d54d6ddf40f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as part of Kids Online Safety Act talks while facing thousands of claims and a recent six million dollar jury verdict.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1dcc6802-3ea2-4c98-912b-2e112e97ae5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Proposed Language:** Would **[grant companies immunity from state claims on safety or privacy of individuals under eighteen](https://substack.com/redirect/b019a040-b88b-400f-9109-c3b5b422c1ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** related to KOSA.
* **Litigation Backdrop:** Includes consolidated California cases state suits and school district actions after negligence finding in bellwether trial.

# [The SpaceX billionaires, who are they?](https://substack.com/redirect/1dcc6802-3ea2-4c98-912b-2e112e97ae5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
SpaceX's IPO lifted Elon Musk's personal stake past $1 trillion dollars while shares climbed 37% percent and **[minted several other billion dollar holdings among executives and early backers.](https://substack.com/redirect/d2503b9f-ac7a-40f2-9998-b0b5850ea45f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
* **Valor Equity Position:** Holds around ninety $96.6 billion dollars with founder Antonio Gracias serving on the board as longtime Musk associate.
* **Luke Nosek Stake:** $6.3 billion dollars as board member since 2008 and PayPal cofounder.
* **Gwynne Shotwell Wealth:** $2.4 billion dollars as president managing daily operations and customer contracts.
* **CFO Bret Johnsen:** $1.2 billion dollars after joining the company in 2011.

# [SpaceX snaps up Cursor in bold move to supercharge weak AI team](https://substack.com/redirect/1dcc6802-3ea2-4c98-912b-2e112e97ae5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
SpaceX bought Anysphere parent of the popular AI coding tool Cursor marking its first major acquisition as a public company **[to vertically integrate and aid SpaceXAI efforts against frontier rivals.](https://substack.com/redirect/d2503b9f-ac7a-40f2-9998-b0b5850ea45f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1dcc6802-3ea2-4c98-912b-2e112e97ae5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Vertical Integration Play:** Acquisition adds top developer application to energy compute and model layers for stronger AI stack.
* **Compute Leverage:** Utilizes billions spent on chips plus capacity already rented to Anthropic and Google.
* **User Loyalty Factor:** Developers love Cursor and refuse to leave the fastest growing AI application platform.
* **Future Hurdles Noted:** Still requires high powered models beyond Cursor and Grok to match top competitors.

# [Burnham victory sets stage to finally boot UK PM Starmer from power](https://substack.com/redirect/1dcc6802-3ea2-4c98-912b-2e112e97ae5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham secured a decisive parliamentary seat win with 54.8% of the vote **[positioning him to challenge UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer](https://substack.com/redirect/671d5d2c-29f6-47b7-89b3-86a07e66a5a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who vows to fight any contest.

---|---|---
* **Election Result:** Defeated Reform UK candidate with high turnout increasing pressure on Labour after poor local showings.
* **Burnham Message:** Calls result a final chance for party to change and act or face no second opportunity.
* **Starmer Response:** Insists he will stand in any leadership race and will not walk away from the role.
* **Party Turmoil:** Cabinet resignations and potential formal challenge loom if prime minister digs in.

# [NetJets suffers first fatal crash, killing prominent Texas VC founder](https://substack.com/redirect/1dcc6802-3ea2-4c98-912b-2e112e97ae5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
NetJets suffered its first fatal accident **[when a Cessna Citation crashed onto a Laredo Texas highway after reporting low fuel](https://substack.com/redirect/71a516f7-3524-4cde-b111-d2be49c1673e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** en route from Mexico to Austin killing influential venture capitalist Joshua Baer.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1dcc6802-3ea2-4c98-912b-2e112e97ae5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Survivor Details:** Two pilots and three teenagers rescued by bystanders in what mayor called near mass fatality miracle.
* **Victim Background:** Fifty year old Joshua Baer founded Austin's Capital Factory tech startup venture firm.
* **Expert Speculation:** Possible fuel leak suspected given aircraft range triple the planned flight distance.
* **Company Stance:** Berkshire subsidiary reaffirms safety focus and pledges full NTSB cooperation without speculation.

Peter,

Juneteenth is a reminder that freedom is not a single day but a promise we have to keep working toward every day.

As a mom and mayor, I have seen how the long fight for civil rights shapes the lives of families here in NEPA. That history touches our schools, our jobs, our health care, and the trust we place in our institutions. We owe it to our neighbors to remember the past honestly and to act so that opportunity is real for everyone.

For me that means fighting corruption so public service actually serves people, not insiders. It means making sure our kids see themselves in school curriculum and that our communities get the jobs, housing, and safe streets they deserve. It means protecting access to health care so no family lives one emergency away from disaster.

If you can, join me this Juneteenth to reflect, learn, and recommit to taking concrete steps toward justice in our district.

Thank you for standing with our community.

Paige Cognetti
Mom, mayor, and candidate for Congress

Healthcare that works better than anywhere in the world. An immigration system grounded in dignity rather than cruelty. An end to the data center corruption draining the water and power of communities across Texas. subject: On Juneteenth

body:
https://emergeamerica.org/ [https://emergeamerica.org/]
Dear Peter,
Today, I’m thinking about how Juneteenth is not only Black history but America's history.
As our nation turns 250, we all need to understand our past to continue building a better future, and Emerge alums are at the center of that.
While we see the current administration trying to roll back our hard-fought victories for equal rights - from their racist gerrymandering efforts, to eliminating Equity and Justice programs, to DOGE firings, all disproportionately affecting Black women - we are clear-eyed about the moment and importance of our work.
We know that they are only trying to hold us back because they know how powerful we really are. But what they don’t understand is that our power is collective and long-term.
That’s why I’m writing to ask you to chip in what you can to support more Black women advancing up the political ladder. Because those closest to the problems have the solutions our country needs in place to win.
Sincerely,
A’shanti
Emerge President and CEO

body:
Our campaign to register new voters -- along with turning out all these voters -- are the two most important things we're doing between now and November.
Vote-suppressing state legislatures are gearing up to pass more restrictive laws. Congress is paralyzed and beholden to the president. Beating our voter registration goal -- again -- to register new voters might be our best hope to turn the tide so we can protect and expand our right to vote.
The math is simple: Every $3 can help register a new voter. Can we count on you to chip in $36 and help register 12 new voters, Team? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=061926_2&amount=36]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemocracyDocket: SAVE America Act would crash voter registration drives [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=061926_2&amount=36]
Team -- the SAVE America Act would eviscerate our fundamental right to vote. So, of course, Donald Trump is pushing for this zombie legislation again, months after we thought it was dead.
The MAGA movement knows that this bill -- from the original SAVE Act to all the various clones -- is the easiest way to deny our right to vote and preserve their power. That's why Trump called for its passage again this week , saying it needed to be passed before he fully nominates a new Director of National Intelligence.

What a privilege to lead and love them! | | | | I ran for Congress— not to be a politician —but because I saw firsthand how broken our system is and how badly we need leaders who still believe in truth, respect the constitution, lead with conviction, and seek accountability here at home from hardworking, honest people. I’ve prosecuted violent criminals, drug traffickers, and corrupt officials—and I’ve brought that same no-nonsense approach to Washington. | | | | There’s plenty more I could say—but I promised you two minutes, so I’ll keep my word. Here’s what it all comes down to: I’m not a career politician. I’m a husband, a dad, and a prosecutor who knows what’s broken in this country—and I couldn’t, in good faith, sit on the sidelines any longer. | | | | I am running for re-election to continue fighting to: 🇺🇸 Protect our families from violent crime and woke agendas 🇺🇸 Restore constitutional freedom across North Carolina and America 🇺🇸 Defend the bedrock values that built this great nation Whether it’s securing the border, ending reckless spending, or standing up for parents and kids, I’m working every single day to make a difference— and I won’t back down. Thanks for giving me a couple minutes of your day. Again, I am so glad you’re here. Friend,

On June 19, 1865, _more than two long years after_ the Emancipation Proclamation was signed, Union soldiers finally arrived in Galveston, Texas, to deliver the message that freedom was now the law of the land. Juneteenth is a celebration of liberation, but it is also a _sobering reminder_ of how far those in power will go to delay, deny, and dilute the rights of Black Americans. **A lot of us weren’t taught about this history in our schools._And you know what they say about not learning from history._** Right now, we’re witnessing a troubling erosion of history, and if we don’t act, we could be doomed to repeat some of its _worst travesties._ Memphis, my home town, is a city built on the bedrock of Black innovation, culture, labor and resistance. This is the place where Ida B. Wells _exposed the horrors of lynching_ , and where Dr. King _stood shoulder-to-shoulder with striking sanitation workers_ in his final days. The billionaire-funded establishment of _today_ is terrified of that legacy. So much so that they’ve drawn _racially gerrymandered maps_ specifically designed to slice up the power of Black communities, dilute your vote, and erase Black representation from our state capital all together. **They want all the power. They want all of the resources. And they want us to accept this as _inevitable._**

_**But we know better.**_ We know that Black history is Tennessee history. As students of that deep history we know, when we organize, we win. As your next Governor, I am going to fight until we overturn these rigged maps and advance a real, material agenda that is both informed by, and attuned to the needs of Black Tennesseans._**We’ll hit the ground running on Day One:**_
* **Livable Wages:** We are going to lift the statewide minimum wage to $20/hour to pull families out of poverty.
* **Healthcare Access:** We will expand Medicaid, eliminate medical debt for low-income families, and protect Black maternal health.
* **Fully Funded Schools:** I will completely defund the voucher scam that robs our neighborhood schools and reinvest those dollars directly into public classrooms.
* **Housing Security: **We will build affordable housing and use TANF funds to wipe out first-and-last-month deposit barriers for lower-income renters.
* **Real Justice: **We will end private prisons, legalize marijuana, and stop the unconstitutional criminalization of poverty.

**We cannot build a better future if we let republicans like Marsha Blackburn, erase the past.** This Juneteenth, we honor history by _committing to _continue the work.__ To take on dark money and rewrite the rules of power in Tennessee, it takes a movement fueled by everyday people. Today is Juneteenth.
It's a day I've thought about deeply every year of my life -- but this year, standing where I'm standing, it hits different.
You probably know the history. On June 19th, 1865, Union soldiers arrived in Galveston, Texas and announced that enslaved people were free. The Emancipation Proclamation had been signed two and a half years earlier. The people of Texas had been kept in bondage long after the law said they shouldn't be -- because the powerful wanted to hold onto power as long as they possibly could.
I think about that when people ask me why I'm running.
I'm not running because it's easy. I'm running because on January 6th, I watched what happens when democracy gets treated like something optional. I've seen how quickly the progress we take for granted can be taken from us.
**And I 'm running because of everyone who came before me -- who bled and marched and got arrested and got back up -- so that someone like me could even have a shot at a seat at the table.**
John Lewis was one of those people. He had his skull fractured on the Edmund Pettus Bridge fighting for something the law had already promised. He spent his whole life closing the gap between what America said it was and what it actually was.
I have a tattoo inspired by him. A black heart for the struggle of Black Americans. Blood tears for the lives lost on Bloody Sunday. Red lightning for the good trouble he told us we had to get into.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5a5eae42-c60e-42b5-8c44-44c45d73fcd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We've made incredible progress. Juneteenth is a federal holiday now. But a holiday isn't enough. We need people in Congress willing to fight every single day to make it real.
**I intend to be one of those people.**
Thank you for being part of this with me. It means more than I can say.
-- Harry

body:
A Fox News poll shows me ahead in Ohio’s Senate race.
#
Peter –
The first public poll of the general election in Ohio was just released, and you need to take a look:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105168?refcode=em20260619-10594&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10594%2E614464%2E_FzjgJ)

This is a warning
This is a warning sign. You need to take this seriously

| | | | _**FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH**_
---
Patriot, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because **what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation**.

_Let me give you the facts._

A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history.

Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming.

**The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections.** It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you.

The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct.

Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage.

**_I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back._**

In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won.

**Ken Paxton can win this race.** President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that.

[**I am asking you today, as someone who has spent five decades fighting for this country and this party, to make an urgent contribution to Ken Paxton's campaign. Peter, Happy Juneteenth! This holiday commemorates June 19th, 1865, when Union troops arrived in Galveston, Texas, declaring that enslaved people were finally free — over two years after the Emancipation Proclamation went into effect. Now, Juneteenth is largely recognized as the nation's second Independence Day. This is a time to celebrate Black history, culture, leadership, and achievement, while also recognizing the challenges that remain. One moment changed Patti Fox's family forever. After her daughter Carissa suffered a devastating brain injury in a crash by an illegal immigrant, Patti turned unimaginable heartbreak into a mission—fighting for justice, advocating for victims, and speaking out on issues impacting Colorado families.
At Freedom Fest, Patti will share her family's powerful story, the lessons she's learned through tragedy, and why she believes Colorado's future is worth fighting for. _**[Get your tickets now]()**_ & watch the video message from her below.

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Beverly Aikins on faith, recovery and the next right thing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Last Christmas, everyone in Beverly Aikins’ family opened a gift she had made by hand. She had not sewn in years.
The machine had been quiet a long time. Somewhere in a decade of getting well, it started running again. She counts that as recovery. Not the headlines. The sewing.
Most people who know Aikins know her secondhand. Her son wrote about her addiction in his 2016 memoir, Hillbilly Elegy. He talked about it again at the 2024 Republican convention, where the cameras found her in the crowd.
This time the questions are hers to answer.

**[Colorado Retreats From Anti-ICE Court Pledge After ‘Sanctuary Confederacy’ Criticism](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Polis signed HB 26-1276, removing a requirement that attorneys certify they wouldn't share court e-filing data with federal immigration enforcement:** one Colorado Springs attorney said the rule forced him to "salute the resistance" just to access the court system, despite not practicing immigration law.

* **First Amendment group FIRE was prepared to sue, calling the requirement a clear viewpoint-based regulation:** the group noted the government cannot lawfully condition court access on a promise not to use information for a purpose the state simply disfavors.

* **House Judiciary immigration chairman Tom McClintock called it a win but warned of a bigger fight ahead:** his panel is working on legislation that would let victims of sanctuary policies sue those jurisdictions for damages tied to released illegal immigrants with criminal records.

Lara Logan will follow her to the microphone. After decades covering wars, terrorism, government corruption and some of the biggest stories in the world, Logan still talks most about people like Peters._ ____
__**[Temper, temper](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY MARK SALLEY | COMMENTARY | JUNE 17** _The Left is having a temper tantrum over America250. The babysitters spent the last 10 to 20 years...letting the children do exactly what they wanted. The children didn’t like mommy’s and daddy’s rules. So the babysitters, rather than enforcing the time-tested rules, let the children break them. And, break the rules they did. They left behind civility, honesty and responsibility._**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**__
**[ICE detention cases are surging in Colorado. The DOJ keeps losing the legal fight.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JUNE 17** _Five people filed habeas corpus petitions challenging their Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention in all of Colorado federal court in 2024. One hundred five filed in 2025. Through June 15th of this year, 722 have filed, and the pace has held at more than 150 a month since March._

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Peter,
_**Dad Doesn't Need Another Tie.**_
This Father's Day, give him something he'll actually remember.
Freedom Fest is coming to Castle Rock June 26–27, bringing together thousands of patriotic Coloradans for two unforgettable days of speakers, entertainment, fellowship, and celebration as we honor America's 250th Birthday and Colorado's 150th Birthday.
Whether your dad is a veteran, a patriot, a history buff, or simply someone who loves this country, Freedom Fest is a gift he'll enjoy long after Father's Day is over.
Join special guests including:
🇺🇸 Greg Gutfeld
🇺🇸 Larry Gatlin
🇺🇸 Dog the Bounty Hunter
🇺🇸 Nick Shirley
🇺🇸 Chris Wright
...and many more.
Make memories together. Celebrate freedom together.
🎟️ Tickets are available now at **[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).**
Because the best gifts aren't things—they're experiences shared with the people who matter most. _**Happy Father's Day from all of us at Rocky Mountain Voice.**_

|

Several generous supporters have already stepped forward and offered to sponsor tickets. A limited number of sponsored tickets will be available.
If you'd like to nominate someone deserving, _**[click here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_

If you believe in what we're building, we'd love your help.
We're currently looking for volunteers to help make Freedom Fest a success. Volunteers who commit to a single 4-hour shift will receive _**complimentary day passes for both days of the festival**_ (evening events not included), allowing you to experience Freedom Fest while helping create something truly special for Colorado. There are a limited number of spots so grab yours before it's too late!
Whether you're greeting guests, assisting vendors, helping in VIP areas, or simply lending a hand where needed, you'll play a part in building what we believe will be the largest freedom-focused celebration Colorado has ever seen.
Interested in volunteering? Reply to this email and we'll connect you with our volunteer team.

## WWI Postcard Reunites Family
A postcard from home helped identify a World War I soldier more than a century after he died in the trenches, and ultimately [reunited two long-separated branches](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO4yAQBeDT2B0WYAdDQbFNumy7JSIwxLMCYwEJ8u1XjrQn-NvR6Ol778_DPCxG3F-_bQIdXsG0kM0OvUZoDYrpHY9cm7PFF3jvmPe2QbHHaTjlglBBmDLeYjzNMnodADjMI2i2SiaVWhgdN62Wp5XKUSq5uAl1o9Kt3gkqhbjNCsSI-kqjgilO6czVtEo2P1l4Uu6C5HIdFgoeWy7T34wXIcQzf6BMLqcx6q21ow7zr4HfB37vvU8JIzZbzuvhe0JSc_QIpZL_hUgoOZEtJyAbxKOS944NyIaVBJswnsSGBoVY4mBv73KORfujY4xYxUV6JYvxS2g_3u6j-b8AAAD__1PPh6U) of his family. Private Thomas Whitaker was found during an excavation in western Belgium alongside five fellow British soldiers. He was still carrying a [postcard from Bradford](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAUhZ9GOw1cEaWg-Jvp5m-3JCiX4W5QDLBjfPuNm-wTbH9yvvOdj6d5Woq0v_7bDbV_eVN9MjueJWKtmM150pFKXW12Gb92SnsNmO1xGWAgOyY7royzFC8jWqc9IuDQoubTzGelBGdt0INibJlwlCNnclHWK8ZHYT24Sa5-XFrSdxuTXAFjA6h-mvmwcL8wWP0M89QIho5qyv1nonuCj1d6Y-7XtLVRh1qP0gz_Gng08Fhtfxv0lw0p3YkGHudJXUnREebS_Rp1IW3YBYxH6bjgEvgoRB_qFtus3XFSjFTkDX9tluIPrP75pbeG7wAAAP__ihV9zQ), England, where some of his relatives still live. That detail gave U.K. Ministry of Defence researchers the clue they needed to narrow down his identity from among more than half a million British soldiers still missing from the war. DNA analysis later confirmed his identity and those of the five other soldiers. On June 10, six new white marble headstones were dedicated at [Tyne Cot Cemetery](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFurDAQRb8GOiN74AEuXLyGbtOmRF48s0xkMLK96_D3ESvlC9KNNFdX59zP23yz7Hl_fNgNDT1ozhTmHUvymDPGuRQ-QsqLjS7ic-ew5xWjPc4ZJPRC9kLp2Vn259zVzhAiYFujUcOoRq07JevVEGqHchlJLUq1g6JWtx2o8Z-GvkPEms3VJnulQcoWdDOMqr0ruktYaIRxqDqJjnOIzVfgC4H8GV4YmyVstTdrzkeq2v8VTBVMpZSGwjeoy-NKVDBd5_vFIgXvGGMSv2KCYtjEGjYUK_ojiefOGcXKSZDd2J_CUsYorFhwz894VjDV0bijsPec-ovusVn2b5r85xlfBn4CAAD__3B5i04) in Zonnebeke, Belgium. Three members of the Whitaker family attended. Joe Whitaker, 22, read a poem he wrote for his great-great-uncle: "At peace in foreign hills, he finally drifts away to sleep, his mind on Bradford mills." "_My children, my grandchildren, anyone, can come and know where Thomas is_ ," said family member Paul Whitaker. "_That is a lovely thing to have_.”
## Britain's Oldest Dancer Goes Viral at 100
Bernard Gilbert didn't choose dancing. At 16, a broken leg ended his rugby career, and doctors told him to [try dancing instead](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHS3CAMhU-DO-2AvIvtgiKNuz9tSg82wlbCggeIPXv7DMkR0qjR6On73o-v5cty4Lh_t28yfvdL9WmJdJdAtVJe7pvPVOpms8v0O3KK9aBsz8-CEjVIDWpanOXwWZ6dM54Iqe_IqGFU4zQ9lewOo58bOY-vcXitk19fOA7K615tesBB9rpj09KkVhNK2eP0GEbVr8qvEjc_4jiIpyTHNeXHz8QNwYdPuig_tvTugjlqPYvovwmcBc7x05DbSuDcggXOsg2lBM53ysFBUxQ4r5mr5VggBUelgrNxowxXugvUBL-ITkgR9pzSxXEHW0FJCbbAwQWCre3o4mwDXOwowcG1gILXGy7-96LLxp03h8BFN4_9bTn85a7_Xfhl8E8AAAD__2rYloo). A friend dragged him to a lesson, where he stood in the doorway until the instructor told him, "Clear off or come in." He stepped onto the floor and never looked back. |
Peter,
Last week, the FBI raided an Ohio voting rights organization and now we just learned they're taking it a step further.
Federal agents descended on the Cleveland office of the Ohio Organizing Collaborative, a grassroots group which has helped hundreds of thousands of Ohioans register to vote. They seized phones and computers from the staff.
They did not stop there. More than 100 agents fanned out across the entire state. They showed up at the homes of organizers and activists tied to the group in Cleveland, Columbus, Cincinnati, Dayton, and Youngstown, and interrogated them about "voter fraud."
No public evidence. No explanation of what the group is even accused of doing. Just federal agents at the doors of people whose only offense is helping their neighbors register to vote. And now we have an alarming update:

The FBI is now expanding the investigation to target the largest progressive voting rights organization, America Votes.
By launching bogus investigations into progressive voting rights organizations, the Trump admin is laying the groundwork for a "voter fraud" conspiracy theory they can use to justify extreme measures to rig the upcoming midterms. This is how a democracy is dismantled. Not all at once, but piece by piece. Raid by raid. Subpoena by subpoena.
Democrats everywhere have to fight back. Our democracy depends on it. Defend Our Courts is leading that charge, and we are fighting on two fronts. First, we are building a firewall of state Supreme Courts with the power to protect free and fair elections, state by state. Second, we are building the movement to reclaim a United States Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.
[Free and fair elections are under an unprecedented assault by the Trump admin. Trita truly represents the best of what it means to be an American with his courage to speak the truth no matter whether that truth is popular in the moment.
But it doesn't even matter if he was right. In America, we believe freedom of speech is sacrosanct. body:
Robert’s using his platform to call out how the ultrawealthy buy political influence with massive checks.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41488%2E3422442%2E2SUM8U)
Peter,
One of the most important tools Democrats have in Congress is oversight: the power to make sure government officials and massive corporations play by the rules instead of ripping off working families.
**Robert Garcia is leading that fight as the top-ranking Democrat on the House Oversight Committee. He’s using his platform to call out how the ultrawealthy buy political influence with massive checks.**
After Elon Musk spent millions to get Donald Trump elected in 2024, Robert unmasked how that influence is being used to cut vital government services to line the pockets of the rich.
Just like how I held people like Jamie Dimon to account in Congress, Robert is exposing the scam that the so-called “Department of Government Efficiency” is running on the American people.
Right now, it’s more important than ever to have leaders like Robert highlighting how big money in politics is hurting everyday Americans.
But doing that work makes you a target. After Prop 50 was passed, Robert’s district became more competitive, and Republicans would love nothing more than to see him lose. Now, he needs to work harder than ever to win his race.
We can’t afford to lose Robert’s voice in Congress, which is why I’m counting on you to join me in supporting his campaign.
**[If you also believe we need strong government oversight to protect working families, split $5 between Robert’s campaign and Truth to Power to help re-elect him this year.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260619_1_ak.x6ouq7&refcode=em20260619-41488&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41488%2E3422442%2E2SUM8U)**

Thank you,
Katie Porter

Former U.S. Congresswoman Katie Porter founded Truth to Power to support the campaigns of her fellow Democrats. Truth to Power supports candidates who will stand up to Donald Trump, fight to lower costs, and protect the environment. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20260619-41488&amounts=&t=22&refcode2=41488_3422442_2SUM8U&akid=41488%2E3422442%2E2SUM8U)**

subject: (ICYMI) The Green Bay Blueprint
body:
Earlier this month, I got to roll out something I’ve been really excited about for a while: The Green Bay Blueprint.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e0cbc460d31b/c2y1sg9w12-10123097?e=f59034ca3e)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/h52iV3sBUTo?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,

Earlier this month, I got to roll out something I’ve been really excited about for a while:**The Green Bay Blueprint**. We got to announce a vision for holding private corporations accountable and making our budget priorities honest with some amazing elected officials in Green Bay, including my good friend Rep. Ryan Spaude.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/24To3LPNKmX?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |

[**We need a State Treasurer who’s willing to fight for accountability, transparency, and our public schools. I need your help in these last six weeks to get the message out and tell everyone about this incredible plan. If you’re able, please chip in and help us reach every voter.**](https://us.list-manage.com/17x1e9fY9w7?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
Here’s a bit more info on the plan:
In November 2023, the Green Bay Area Public School District Board of Education passed a resolution supporting voucher transparency and requested that voucher-related levies be clearly disclosed on property tax bills. In April 2025, the Green Bay City Council voted to support adding this information under the “Note” section of tax bills.**Beginning on the December 2025 property tax bills, residents will see the amount that the District levies additionally to pay for the voucher program.**
_**I want this program to be enacted all over our state so taxpayers know how much of their money is going to our critical public schools vs. unaccountable corporations**_.
Wisconsinites deserve clear, accessible information about where their money goes. Green Bay built the blueprint for how we can be transparent with taxpayers. People should know how much of our money is going towards public education and how much is going to private vouchers. Organizers and public education leaders, like those at the Wisconsin Public Education Network (WPEN), have seen real success with these efforts, and this transparency is needed statewide.
I believe we deserve a State Treasurer’s office that brings back the energy of Sarah Godlewski and fights for our shared good. Let’s start by being honest about where our dollars are going and what we can do for our incredible educators.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1C6KUeJfZnQ?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |

We know that we can do better when the government works in people’s best interest rather than disguising private costs behind public documents. If you’re able, [please throw us a few dollars today](https://us.list-manage.com/MhdWiEhISDD?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09) so we can make The Green Bay Blueprint a Wisconsin-wide initiative.
Thank you,Dylan

name: Adam Dunigan for Congress
subject: What Juneteenth asks of us
body:
Don't wait to vote. They didn't wait to fight for your right to.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/2UBg56vshMV?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| | | | | |

---
| |
Adam here,

On June 19, 1865, Union troops reached Galveston, Texas and announced that enslaved people there were free. The Emancipation Proclamation had been signed two and a half years earlier. Freedom existed on paper before it existed in fact — and the distance between those two things was filled by people who had every reason to make sure word never arrived.
That gap between the law and the lived reality is the story of Juneteenth. It's also, frankly, the story of this country's relationship with the right to vote. The 15th Amendment passed in 1870. It took another century, and the work of people who were beaten, jailed, and killed for it, before that promise was anything more than ink. The Voting Rights Act of 1965 didn't hand anyone a gift — it was wrenched into existence by people who refused to wait any longer for paper rights to become real ones.
I think about that legacy every time I think about why I'm running. I spent over a decade overseas working to protect the idea that people get to choose their own government. It would be strange, and a little hollow, to come home and not fight just as hard for that same idea here — especially for the communities who have had to fight hardest and longest to make it real.
---
| [DONATE $25 TODAY Help Me Fight to Ensure Everyone’s Voice is Heard ](https://us.list-manage.com/uOLjq9YmWhm?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---
| |
We should celebrate this day. But any celebration should come with the somber understanding that Black Americans today are still living through the consequences of America’s past moral failings.
I don’t have their lived experience with that history; and I don’t claim to. But, I do have a platform now, and I’m going to use that platform to force reflection on our complicated past.
If we want a country we can be proud of, there is so much work to do. Not just for the day-to-day improvement of our lives and our government, but in correcting and contextualizing the inadequacies of our justice system and our schools.

****_(My campaign staff member Natalie in 2020. She was instrumental in organizing Black Lives Matter rallies in Northern Virginia. Making me proud as usual.)_
Here's the thing about all of that history outlined above: it didn't happen because people were granted rights out of generosity. It happened because people showed up and used the rights they had, loudly and persistently, until the people in power had no choice but to recognize them.
We get a small version of that same chance right now. Early voting opened yesterday for our August 4 primary. You don't have to wait three more weeks. You can walk into your registrar's office today and vote.
I won't pretend our primary carries the same stakes as the fights I just described. But there's something real in the act itself. Every single person who shows up early, ahead of schedule, on their own time, is making a quiet statement: _this matters to me, and I'm not waiting to be told when to care._ That posture — showing up early, showing up loud, refusing to wait — is exactly the one this moment calls for, on every front.

Today, on Juneteenth, if you haven’t: **Go vote early**.
Tell a friend to do the same. And if you're able, [**chip in $25**](https://us.list-manage.com/rmW7FQQOFQI?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0); not because we're short on time, but because the people doing this work, the ones I just named and the ones organizing in your own neighborhood, deserve to know they're not doing it alone.
Showing up on Juneteenth means showing up and putting in the work on the other 364 days too. And that’s what I’m trying to do.

---

---
| |
In solidarity,**Adam Dunigan**
Congressional Candidate
Virginia's 8th District

name: Sarah Elfreth
subject: Juneteenth and the ongoing fight for voting rights
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Elfreth for Maryland
body:
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/]
Friend,

On June 19, 1865, more than two years after the Emancipation Proclamation was signed, Union soldiers finally arrived in Galveston, Texas, to announce that all enslaved people were free.

Juneteenth is a profound celebration of liberation, resilience, and the unyielding spirit of Black Americans who fought for their humanity and their rights. But history reminds us that the achievement of legal freedom was only the beginning of a long, ongoing journey toward true equality.

At the very heart of that journey has always been the right to vote and fully participate in this American experiment.

From the Reconstruction era through the civil rights movement, generations of leaders marched, organized, and sacrificed everything to secure the franchise. They understood a fundamental truth: the ballot is our most powerful tool to protect our families, support our communities, and hold power accountable.

Today, that legacy is under a renewed and coordinated attack. Across the nation, we are witnessing modern voter suppression tactics designed to make it harder for working families, students, and communities of color to make their voices heard.

We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines. We honor the legacy of Juneteenth not just with words, but with our actions.

With our primary election right around the corner, we have a responsibility to carry that history with us to the polls. Please take a moment today to double-check your voting details, look up your polling place, and make your plan to vote.

CONFIRM YOUR VOTING REGISTRATION & SITE HERE ➔ [https://voterservices.elections.maryland.gov/VoterSearch]

True progress requires persistent, unapologetic action. Let's honor those who came before us by standing up, showing up, and protecting the sacred right they fought so hard to win.

Wishing you and your family a meaningful, reflective Juneteenth.

In solidarity,

Sarah Elfreth
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/] https://www.facebook.com/SarahforMD [https://www.facebook.com/SarahforMD] https://www.instagram.com/SarahforMaryland [https://www.instagram.com/SarahforMaryland] https://x.com/SarahforMD [https://x.com/SarahforMD]
Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. And Sarah has delivered on her promises. She has spent her first year in the House advocating for the Third District, successfully passing five bills into law, solving over 1,000 constituent cases, and bringing tens of millions in funding back to her community. She learned her work ethic and tenacity from growing up in a union household and honed her skills of problem-solving and collaborating over six years in the Maryland State Senate. Sarah lives in Annapolis with her fiancé, Eric, and their dog, Ollie. ### Peter —
In recent weeks, we have shared news about the candidates running, the signatures gathered, and forward momentum for independents this cycle. This week, we're focusing on the fight to make sure independent candidates can even get that far. The Forward Party announced support for a lawsuit against the State of Texas this week, and we want you to understand why. 81,030 is the key number here. That is the number of valid voter signatures Texas requires an independent statewide candidate to collect, **with only 30 days to do it.** The Forward Party is officially supporting Texas independent candidate for Lieutenant Governor Mike Collier who [filed a lawsuit](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=RbB0mcrKghZbx7vJFbVRj5_rF4HXYHMDfXhJzhdm-QGMiNI2RdHcCwm_U2ROoPWk&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_106&n=1) challenging the state's ballot access requirements for independent statewide candidates. It was filed in cooperation with the Center for Competitive Democracy. Here's what Texas law actually requires: an independent candidate for statewide office must collect more than **81,030 valid voter signatures.** That alone would be a serious challenge for any campaign, but Texas adds another twist. Independent candidates are legally prohibited from beginning that signature collection process until _after_ the partisan primary runoff elections have concluded. This year, that meant the clock didn't start until May 26th, when Texas's primary runoffs wrapped up. Independent petitions are due June 25th. **That leaves independent candidates just 30 days to collect more signatures than most statewide campaigns gather in six months.** It gets more restrictive. Texas law also sharply limits _who is allowed to sign_ an independent candidate's petition. Any voter who participated in a party primary or runoff election is disqualified from signing an independent candidate's petition. Combine a pressed 30-day timeline with a shrunken pool of eligible signers, and you get a system that is not only expensive but also logistically difficult to navigate. That is by design. As the lawsuit argues, these barriers serve no public purpose other than locking independent candidates, and the voters who want to support them, out of the democratic process entirely. Whether it's gerrymandered districts that reduce competition or ballot access laws that keep independent candidates off the ballot entirely, the result is the same: fewer meaningful choices for voters, and a political system built to protect incumbents and party insiders rather than the people they're supposed to serve. **Please forward this to your friends, family, and coworkers. It helps us introduce them to Forward and to what we are building. Also consider inviting them to one of our upcoming events listed below. We'd love to meet them.**

# [Commemorating Juneteenth](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=202596260&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAyNTk2MjYwLCJpYXQiOjE3ODE5MDMxMTIsImV4cCI6MTc4NDQ5NTExMiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.kYon7m4omu48NTap2pFbAjNk-hF3qmYkPNiA8dIwpzc)
### Celebrating freedom and renewing the commitment to the fight
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jun 19
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..DtJn9U3BvOHB4l81LWeRVI90Zn1ILUkPr-UKJirVg7c?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/commemorating-juneteenth?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends,
On this day 161 years ago, the last group of enslaved people in Texas learned that they were free. For Black communities all over America, today is a day of celebration and joy.
And as Trump and the MAGA GOP continue their mission to erode voting rights and civil liberties, it is more crucial than ever that we take time to reflect on how far we've come and look toward the work that still lies ahead.
We are still working every day toward that more perfect union, friends. I know that, you know that, and that's one of the inescapable truths about Juneteenth. It's a day of celebration that marks the end of an atrocity that our country endorsed for far too long.
But it is also a reminder that we, the American people, have been able to come together and fight for progress. That every step taken toward building a more perfect union is a hard-won victory made possible by the hard work and dedication of folks who believe that we as a nation can do better.
**That 's the kind of legacy we need to uphold today.**
Right now, Donald Trump, the MAGA GOP in Congress, and the far-right Supreme Court are working together to make it harder for all of us to vote - and explicitly working to dilute Black voting power and strip representation away from Black communities.
In April, there was the Supreme Court ruling in _Louisiana v. Callais_ that made it easier for MAGA Republicans to draw maps that dilute Black voting power. _The New York Times_ reported that the ruling could allow Republican legislatures to erase around a dozen majority-minority House seats across the South. Justice Elena Kagan warned that the court's decision would set back "the foundational right" of racial equality in representation.
Then there's the SAVE Act, which Trump is still trying to pressure Congress into passing. That bill would restrict the freedom to vote and require Americans to produce a passport or birth certificate to register to vote.
And there are Trump's ongoing attacks on vote-by-mail - the system relied on by seniors, members of our military, disabled voters, and shift workers. The system Trump himself uses, by the way.
_This is an effort to dilute the vote of Black Americans and trample on the very ideals this country was founded on._
**And here 's the truth: **Unless all of us stand up and fight back to defend our rights in this moment, there is a very real risk that Donald Trump and his far-right minions will succeed at turning our country into a place we no longer recognize.
That's exactly why I'm in this race in the first place. This campaign is built on real American values - the values of freedom, equality, liberty, and justice for all. And it's built on the spirit of the Juneteenth message: No one is free until we are all free.
Because all of us, regardless of identity or background, deserve dignity, opportunity, and a fair shot. That's why I'm running to be Michigan's next senator.
With grit, gratitude, hope, and determination,
Haley
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/b88d17e0-5e86-4a96-b295-4e034e337a5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

#
Peter — we’re approaching one of the last official quarterly FEC deadlines of this campaign.
With that important deadline coming up fast, we’ve had to make a difficult decision. And we felt we owed it to you to explain it.
Over the past 12 months we’ve spent upwards of $12 million backing candidates in races around the country. We have one of the strongest slates we’ve ever had, and our candidates have the potential to take back not just the House, but the Senate as well.

Peter,
With just days to go until our Primary Election, we’re reaching out to our strongest supporters like you with an update on our campaign.
Unfortunately, because our campaign is legally barred from fundraising during Maryland’s legislative session, we started this year behind our opponents.
**Wes paused all fundraising efforts during the state legislative session earlier this year to focus on governing — lowering costs, strengthening schools, and delivering for Maryland families.**
Our opponents didn’t. Republicans kept raising money to try to take back the governor’s office and roll back our progress.
**Now, we only have a few days to make up ground before the General Election season kicks off.** So we’re asking you directly:

Team Moore

You've felt it even if you haven't named it.
The small businesses that closed because they couldn't compete with a corporation that was willing to lose money for years just to drive them out. The hospital that merged, then merged again, then started billing you three times what it used to. The grocery store where two or three conglomerates quietly control every brand on every shelf while prices keep climbing. The internet provider with no competition and no incentive to treat you like a customer worth keeping.
This is what unchecked corporate power looks like, and it didn't happen by accident.
It happened because the people sent to Washington to enforce anti-trust law, to break up monopolies, to stand between corporate greed and the working people of this country **chose the corporations instead.**
**[I believe we should build policy around the needs of working families and local communities, not the demands of powerful corporations.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/855f2156-5ec0-464d-a306-cb6703d616d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

[ Join Our Fight Today. Click HERE.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/855f2156-5ec0-464d-a306-cb6703d616d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
My opponent is Scott DesJarlais. He has never met a corporate consolidation he felt compelled to fight. He has never championed anti-trust enforcement and never stood on the floor of Congress and demanded that the companies eating this district alive be held accountable for what they've done to working families, small businesses, and local economies.
He's too scared to bite the hand that feeds him. _And corporate America feeds him very well._
I grew up around addiction, abuse, and crime. I know what it feels like when the people who are supposed to protect and lead you let you down. I have seen firsthand the pain that follows when those with power look the other way while families and communities pay the price.
That's why I have never had much patience for leaders who serve themselves instead of the people they represent. I know what happens when ordinary people don't have a voice, and I know the only way to change it is to send people to Washington who work for their communities, not the special interests that can afford to buy influence.
**My dedication means nothing without your help. Let 's stand together!**

America is facing many challenges. The national debt continues to climb. Families struggle with inflation. Crime remains a concern in many communities. Parents battle for influence over what their children are taught in schools. Religious liberty faces increasing pressure, and many Americans wonder if the nation is moving away from the principles that made it strong. Conservatives spend countless hours discussing these issues on social media, in churches, around dinner tables, and at community gatherings.

name: Justin Kwasa, LCV
subject: Juneteenth
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM3OTMzMTUS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQ4MDg3NTg2MgS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Happy Juneteenth, Peter. This Juneteenth, LCV celebrates Black freedom while doubling down on our
commitment to racial and environmental justice. As we reflect on the history and
ongoing struggle for racial equity in the U.S., we can’t lose sight of what’s at
stake today. And right now, the Trump administration is trying to undermine
hard-won rights for Black people and other people of color. In the past couple
of months alone: The Supreme Court gutted what was left of the Voting Rights Act, opening the floodgates for a wave of racial gerrymandering in states across the country.Trump issued an unconstitutional Executive Order attacking vote-by-mail, requiring the U.S. Postal Service to send out mail ballots only to voters pre-approved by the federal government. This move could disenfranchise millions of voters who are legally entitled to vote by mail, according to their state laws.Trump nominated his own former defense lawyer, Todd Blanche, to lead the Department of Justice. As Deputy Attorney General, Blanche has helped weaponize the Justice Department and recently attempted to give 1.8 billion taxpayer dollars to the president and his fellow insurrectionists. Blanche at the head of the Justice Department is a dangerous power grab serving Trump and his cronies, while endangering the freedoms and protections our communities need and deserve. Threats to our democracy like these are exactly why LCV works to build power
with supporters like you — and when our movement shows up together, we win. In
fact, LCV state affiliates, Georgia Conservation Voters and Conservation Voters
South Carolina, were both key players in their states’ successful campaigns to
block mid-decade redistricting efforts, which were direct legislative attacks on
Black members of Congress. With the 2026 midterms right around the corner, it’s crucial that we keep
winning. And we’re pulling out all the stops to do just that by working with our
state affiliates to mobilize voters, building grassroots power across the
country, and helping to elect and protect pro-democracy, pro-climate, and
pro-clean energy leaders in November. I hope you enjoy and honor the legacy of Juneteenth this weekend, and I thank
you for standing with LCV to defend our democracy — for all people and our
planet. Yours in the Movement, Justin Kwasa
Director, Democracy Program
League of Conservation Voters This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If this isn't the best email address at which to reach you,update your contact information https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/ContactInformation?spMailingID=13793315&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjQ4MDg3NTg2MgS2&spReportId=MjQ4MDg3NTg2MgS2.Click here to unsubscribe https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/Unsubscribe?spMailingID=13793315&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjQ4MDg3NTg2MgS2&spReportId=MjQ4MDg3NTg2MgS2 from our supporter list.Send us any comments, criticisms, or feedback here mailto:feedback@lcv.org?subject=, or just reply to this email! Thanks for your support.

subject: Happy Juneteenth! Walk with Enoch for Congress in Tomorrow's Parade
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer
body:
Today, we celebrate freedom, resilience, and the ongoing journey toward a more just and equitable America.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | Hello Peter,
Happy Juneteenth!
Today, we celebrate freedom, resilience, and the ongoing journey toward a more just and equitable America. Juneteenth commemorates June 19, 1865—the day when enslaved African Americans in Texas finally learned they were free, more than two years after the Emancipation Proclamation. It is a reminder that freedom is not simply declared; it must be protected, expanded, and made real for every generation.
As we celebrate the progress that has been made, we also honor those who fought, sacrificed, organized, and persevered so that future generations could have greater opportunities. Their courage inspires us to continue working for economic justice, voting rights, quality education, affordable healthcare, and equal opportunity for all.
Tomorrow, I invite you to join the **Enoch for Congress** team as we participate in the **North College Hill Juneteenth Parade**. Our campaign is proud to stand alongside community members celebrating freedom, unity, and hope for the future.

### Parade Details
📅 **Saturday, June 20, 2026**
📍 **North College Hill Stadium Staging Area**
⏰ **Arrive by 7:30 AM** (no later than 8:00 AM)
🚶 **Parade begins at 9:00 AM**
The Enoch for Congress team is scheduled as **Entry #9** in the parade lineup and will include walkers and a campaign vehicle.
Whether you have volunteered before or are joining us for the first time, we would love to have you walk with us. Bring your family, your friends, your energy, and your commitment to building a stronger community.

### Why Walk?
✅ Celebrate Juneteenth and the legacy of freedom
✅ Promotes campaign visibility
✅ Meet neighbors from across the community
✅ Help build momentum for our campaign
✅ Show that our district is ready for leadership that puts people first
Our campaign is powered by everyday people who believe that everyone deserves a fair shot at success. Every conversation, every volunteer, and every step we take together helps bring that vision closer to reality.
If you can join us, please reply to this email or contact our volunteer team today.
Thank you for your continued support, and once again, Happy Juneteenth!Together, we can build a future worthy of those who came before us and the generations yet to come.
In solidarity,
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
**P.S.** Wear comfortable shoes, bring water, and wear your Enoch for Congress shirt if you have one. If you need a shirt, shoot me your size in this email, and I will bring on with me to the parade. Let's show North College Hill the strength of our movement tomorrow morning! ☀️🇺🇸✊🏿
Candidate for U.S. Congress, Ohio's 8th DistrictPaid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer.

The U.S. military recently carried out a kinetic strike on the leader of Tren de Aragua in another move that puts the rest of Latin America on notice, particularly on Mexico.
Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores, known as Niño Guerrero, has been credited with growing Tren de Aragua from a local gang in one Venezuelan state to an international threat by taking advantage of the mass exodus of Venezuelans during the 2010s and 2020s.
TdA was primarily limited to South America, but the Biden-Harris administration's open border policies allowed many members to freely enter the United States and establish cells across the country. Guerrero Flores had been incarcerated in a prison TdA controlled, but was able to evade capture when Venezuelan security forces conducted an operation to regain control of the facility. Guerrero Flores' run from authorities ended with the U.S. strike.
Even a year ago, such a move seemed unlikely, but at the same time it is not surprising given that President Donald Trump had repeatedly warned the U.S. was done being passive on foreign gangs operating freely. That includes operating with impunity in other countries. Taking out TdA's leader in a bold and public way accomplishes Trump's promise.

Charlie saw something rare in JD Vance | | | |
---
| | | Fellow Patriot,

Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, this is a
long but meaningful email that I hope you’ll read to the end.

In New York’s 13th district, Democratic socialist Darializa Avila
Chevalier is surging in the polls against one of the last remaining
members of the city’s political machine, Rep. Adriano Espaillat — and the
primary is only six days from now.

Justice Democrats was proud to launch Darializa’s campaign for Congress
back in November, but our story together didn’t start there. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260619-2-dac.L2VoF8&refcode=em20260619-37931&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=37931%2E1203867%2EWaMWQf ]Before I
share more, will you rush $10 to help us elect her next
Tuesday?

Darializa is a working-class, Afro-Latina, and UAW union member who has
been organizing in upper Manhattan for a fairer, more equitable, and more
affordable New York City since she was a teenager.

The daughter of working-class, Dominican immigrant parents, she witnessed
loved ones struggle with immigration issues, socioeconomic inequality, and
the criminal justice system throughout her life.

Darializa saw firsthand how ICE has terrorized communities in New York and
across the country, and directly fought back. During Donald Trump’s first
term, she organized to help free U.S. permanent resident Abdikadir Mohamed
from his 1.5-year ICE detention caused by the 2017 ‘Muslim ban,’ reunited
separated immigrant families as an organizer at Families for Freedom, and
then became an investigator for the public defender’s office in Harlem
supporting New Yorkers on some of the hardest days of their lives.

Darializa’s organizing has also been defined by her commitment to
Palestinian freedom and an end of U.S. complicity in Israel’s genocide in
Gaza. As an undergraduate at Columbia University, Darializa participated
in a summer abroad program in the West Bank of Palestine, where she
learned Arabic and taught English to Palestinian children living in nearby
refugee camps.

She went on to organize for a free Palestine after returning to campus in
New York. From 2023-2024, Darializa worked alongside her friend Mahmoud
Khalil — who ICE famously kidnapped and detained — as one of the lead
organizers of the Columbia University encampment. She also organized with
a collective in NY-13 called Uptown for Palestine, which tried reaching
their representative, Adriano Espaillat, on this issue for over 15 months
to no avail.

Funded by AIPAC, Adriano was silent on Israel’s genocide and has never
missed a vote to fund Israel’s military. Then, when questioned about Trump
targeting Mahmoud for exercising his freedom of speech, the Congressman
didn’t fight for his constituent. Instead, he said that he “trusted”
Trump’s Department of Justice to “follow the law.”

It further confirmed that this 5-term, corporate-backed incumbent was
completely out of touch and unwilling to fight for New Yorkers like
Mahmoud — which meant he was unwilling to fight for any of us.

After organizing this district to help democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani
win the New York mayoral race by double digits, Darializa believed the
time had come for New Yorkers to replace Adriano. She actually emailed
Justice Democrats in February 2025, looking to strategize around finding
someone to challenge her absent Congressman, Adriano Espaillat!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260619-2-dac.L2VoF8&refcode=em20260619-37931&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=37931%2E1203867%2EWaMWQf ]Screengrab of an email from Darializa Avila Chevalier to Justice
Democrats: "A few of us have been thinking that it might be worth
introducing an electoral strategy to unseat or push him on his policies.
Personally, my organizing experience is in grassroots/direct action work
and would love to talk with someone who would be willing to do some
strategy/power mapping with us on the feasibility of an electoral strategy
against an establishment Dem. Is this something you'd be interested in? If
so, is there a window of time where we could meet to discuss further? I
know it's a really hard and busy time for most of us, so I really
appreciate your time! Sincerely, Darializa Avila Chevalier"

But Darializa never saw herself as the candidate to take on Espaillat. She
was a community organizer who wanted to support Justice Democrats to
connect with people on the ground to find the right challenger to their
do-nothing incumbent.

Then, in the middle of our 2026 candidate recruitment last August, we
realized that multiple community members had nominated Darializa to run
for Congress against Adriano. It became clear when we met with her, talked
to people on the ground, and heard from community leaders that Darializa
was the type of leader who was taking on hard fights on behalf of her
community — no matter the personal cost. She was never afraid to stand up
to wealthy and powerful interests making life more expensive in NY-13. We
knew she was the perfect candidate to take on this corporate-backed AIPAC
Democrat in a moment when New Yorkers are clearly ready for bold,
progressive change.

We recruited Darializa to run, and despite her reservations, she stepped
up to the challenge because she knew her community deserved better. Now,
after building a mighty people-powered campaign over the last 8 months,
she is on the verge of winning one of the most monumental primaries in NYC
history and taking down a political machine next week!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260619-2-dac.L2VoF8&refcode=em20260619-37931&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1004&akid=37931%2E1203867%2EWaMWQf ]But we’re running out of time to make it happen. Split a grassroots
contribution of any amount to Darializa’s campaign and Justice Democrats
now to get her over the finish line in Tuesday’s election →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260619-2-dac.L2VoF8&refcode=em20260619-37931&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1023&akid=37931%2E1203867%2EWaMWQf ]Contribute $10

This is why this work matters and your support is so crucial for our
movement. From the first emails to the final ballots, we’re only able to
recruit and support candidates like Darializa because of people like you,
so thank you for anything you can give to fuel our work during the rest of
this cycle and beyond.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | $7M+ Revenue 1.5M users.
